Local changes: MMMG/VOIC/EXVO/SEQU and validated mono Mwa StreamPCM support;
see PATCHES.md and patches/0001-mmmg-sequ.patch, 0002-mwa-stream-pcm.patch.
Browser binary is compiled locally with tools/build-smaf.py and Emscripten 3.1.64.
Preset FM instruments are approximate, not the original Yamaha ROM.
